name: Perle
steps: Open app.perle.xyz and sign in with Google, an email code or a Solana wallet such as Phantom, Solflare or Backpack. The sign-up asks for no ID.
If you signed in with Google or email, link a Solana wallet in Settings. Keep a little SOL in it: the app checks for at least 0.001 SOL before it records an answer on Solana.
Open the Marketplace and do the Educational projects first. They are the qualification step that unlocks the other projects.
Check your points on the Dashboard and under Earnings.
If you took the six-month lock in March, claim your PRL at claim.perle.xyz before 21 March 2027.
what: Perle's PRL airdrop for early contributors is closed. Season 2 points have no stated payoff. How the AI data tasks work, what they cost and the risks.
behind: Perle, Inc. runs the platform. Its founder and chief executive, Ahmed Rashad, studied at MIT, worked at Amazon and was an early head of operations at Scale AI, according to Perle's team page. The company says it has raised $17.5 million: $8.5 million in October 2024 led by CoinFund, and a $9 million seed round led by Framework Ventures in August 2025. Halborn reviewed the PRL token in March 2026 a
costs: Perle asks for no fee, deposit or purchase. The only cost is Solana network fees, and the app wants at least 0.001 SOL in your wallet to submit an answer and 0.01 SOL to claim a badge. The work is paid in points only.
risks: No written terms cover the points program. The terms on Perle's site don't mention points, rewards or tokens. The March airdrop excluded US persons and people in Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Crimea, Donetsk and Luhansk, and its claim page blocked VPN users.
